title: Atlas Flows: finder overview
summary: The bare /flows address as a finder overview: one search box over flow names, step labels and text, io_contracts input and output field names, and AC ids, entities and screens; facet filters with counts (Product, Actor with Code, AI agent, Person and Jev, Kind, Realization, Level, Uses field, Produces field, Entity, Screen, and 'I/O not yet defined'); applied-filter chips with Clear all; and results grouped by flow, where each matching step row carries an actor badge, the reason it matched and a link to /flows/<product>/<flow>?step=<id>. Search and filter state live in the /flows query string so a search can be shared. Eleven states: the overview, three field and search states, Jev, AC-id prefix, entity and screen, two 'I/O not yet defined' states and the empty 'No flows match' state. From leafcutter/atlas-flows v4.

provenance.note: Drafted from leafcutter/atlas-flows v4 (FlowFinderQuery, Flow, FlowNode, FlowRoute, FlowNavigation); styled from the Atlas tokens via docs/ui-context.md (globals.css, tailwind.config.ts, layout.tsx). Placed in the atlas-flows/ sub-folder because mockups/leafcutter/ already exceeds the 15-file folder-density cap.
